config.fee_model: constant chips per hand equivalent to the configured bb/100; illustrative sensitivity, not pot rake or an asserted realistic site schedule
config.independent_block: all three frozen own policies in both seats on one shared deck; resample the entire six-hand block
config.limits: conditional empirical block-resampling model, not out-of-sample validation; frozen strategies do not adapt to fees; no external reference/benchmark policy or outcomes used for learning
config.uncertainty: one-sided five-opponent Bonferroni-Hoeffding lower mean; worst-case bounded-return log growth from that lower mean

limits: conditional empirical resampling, not independent strength validation; fixed illustrative fees, not real-site pot rake; uncertainty fraction is separate from fitted-law optimum
